fairness: The README says every outbound call goes through a transport that retries on timeout, and the gateway documents idempotency keys. Charging a customer twice for one order is a defect under any reading of the request; the hidden tests check the amount debited when the provider times out after applying a charge, and the ordinary path.
naive: Calls transport.call(gateway.charge, customer, amount) with no idempotency key, so a retried timeout debits twice.
